title: ChurchEventPlanningInput
description: Input data schema for generating church event master plans.

event_name.description: Title of the event (e.g., Marriage Night: Strengthening the Bond).

purpose_and_goals.description: Why the church is holding this event and intended outcomes.

target_date_and_time.description: Date, start time, and scheduled end time.

location_and_spaces.description: Venue, campus rooms, outdoor fields, or off-site location.

target_audience.description: Target demographic (e.g., Married couples, Families with kids, Youth, Community neighbors).
